name: Porwal Auto Components Limited
summary: Porwal Auto Components Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of automotive auxiliary parts, primarily serving the commercial vehicle sector. The company also undertakes the manufacturing of a wide array of casting components and subassemblies, utilizing materials such as ductile iron, grey cast iron, steel, and various steel alloys. Its products cater to a diverse range of industries, including automotive, engineering, pumps and valves, agricultural and tractor equipment, construction machinery, machine tools, and railways. Established on February 3, 1992, the firm maintains its main operational base in Dhar, India.
